crossRefs.note: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of…
It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.
For Yahweh says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.
Circumcise yourselves to Yahweh, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Judah and inhabitants of…
Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,
and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word…

parallels.note: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

translations.web: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.
translations.bsb: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings.
translations.kjv: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
translations.asv: And others fell upon the thorns; and the thorns grew up and choked them:
